# A shadow-pilot export from a cold review, 2026-10-12

From a cold review, 2026-10-12, copied byte for byte. Six bills in eight rows. Two of them carry one invoice number,
GCS-20417, on two dates under two spellings of the vendor: the second is the duplicate the team paid. `export/` has no `ref`
column, `export2/` has one; `mapping.json` and `mapping2.json` map each; `PREREG.md` is the frozen pre-registration the run used. The test that reads them is `test/pilot-merged-numbers.test.ts`.
